ambiguities.intent: Read input columns as text before applying the required Timely Response conversion; preserve textual identifiers.

ambiguities.source_text: Standardise the Timely Response field so it can be output consistently
ambiguities.intent: For input Timely Response, strip surrounding whitespace and compare case-insensitively: true, 1 and yes map to True; false, 0 and no map to False; all other values map to False.

ambiguities.source_text: As of 26th June 2024, any complaints still marked In Progress should be considered resolved on that date
ambiguities.ref:
in_progress = df["Response to Consumer"].astype(str).str.strip().eq("In Progress")
df.loc[in_progress, "Date Resolved"] = "26/06/2024"
ambiguities.intent: Set Date Resolved to 26 June 2024 for complaints whose Response to Consumer is In Progress; keep all complaints and leave other resolved dates unchanged.
